title: The Sensor Log
description: An old sensor in the observatory of Numera records a sequence of readings. When the whole log is fed into a mysterious machine, the machine prints a single number. The rule behind this number is hidden. Study the examples carefully and reproduce the machine's output for any log of readings.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer N, the number of readings.
The second line contains N space-separated integers, the readings in the order they were recorded.
output_format: Print a single integer, the number printed by the machine.
